summary: Extends Mobile IPv6 and NEMO, which originally supported only IPv6, to register IPv4 addresses and prefixes and carry both IPv4 and IPv6 packets through the tunnel to the home agent. It also allows the mobile node to roam across IPv4-only networks.

eli5.summary: A traveling device can keep both its old-style and new-style addresses and still be reached. This note makes that work through a tunnel back home.

questions: how does mobile ipv6 support ipv4
